svg.title: PortableSatStation three-axis multimode architecture
svg.desc: Conceptual architecture separating fixed CM5 on the official CM5 I/O board, separate custom auxiliary PCB, two replaceable LimeSDR Mini modules, GNSS, remote compass, RF handedness selector and power from a rotating AZ, EL and limited POL assembly. Two USB 3 paths are reserved directly for one SDR each. USB audio via a qualified powered hub or documented USB 2 host remains unselected and unverified. The wireless 4 GB RAM, 16 GB eMMC CM5 is a candidate. POL driver candidate is Watterott TMC5160 v1.5 with SPI1, ramp jumper open and EN high=disabled; exact interface/pin mapping awaits PCB freeze. Intended dual-band VHF/UHF RX; both SDRs are TX-capable but hardware safety permits only one active TX path. Bluetooth audio selects one RX channel without mixing or decoding both. Conditional 5 W FM carrier, 5 W PEP USB and 1 W AM carrier objectives are not tested; native SDR output is low power. GNSS provides site and UTC, not stationary heading. RHCP/LHCP selection is independent of mechanical POL roll.
svg.text: FIG-01 - PortableSatStation three-axis architecture
Concept only. Official CM5 I/O + separate auxiliary PCB; revision-A GPIO software map exists, but auxiliary hardware is not released.
FIXED BASE - tripod / tray (computer, battery and shielded RF stay here)
CM5 (wireless / 4 GB / 16 GB candidate)
Official CM5 I/O board + separate aux PCB
Two USB 3 paths direct: one to each LimeSDR
Audio USB hub or USB 2 host: TBD / unverified
3-axis motion + safety interface
Aux PCB: 3 motors / sensors / audio / safety
POL: Watterott TMC5160 v1.5; SPI1 / ramp
Jumper open; EN high=off; pin map TBD
Two replaceable LimeSDR Mini modules
SDR-A VHF + SDR-B UHF; dual RX
Two direct USB 3 links; concurrent dual RX to verify
Both TX-capable; one active TX path maximum
Goals untested: 5 W FM / 5 W PEP USB / 1 W AM
Independent RF handedness selector
145 MHz feed/phase path: RHCP / LHCP
435 MHz feed/phase path: RHCP / LHCP
All RF ports: conventional 50-ohm SMA
Check contact/gender; PTT off -> switch -> TX permit
Audio / data processing
BT selects one RX; bidirectional PCM under development
K1 dual-plug 3.5/2.5 audio/PTT target; model TBD
USB audio via powered hub or USB 2 host: TBD
Protected power + physical controls
Battery, branch fuses, latching stop TBD
Watchdog and stop cover all 3 motor channels
GNSS receiver/antenna + remote compass / base-inclination IMU
GNSS UART/PPS and compass pins TBD until carrier PCB freeze; sensors unimplemented.
Stationary GNSS is not heading; field-check calibrated compass against manual true heading.
MOVING ASSEMBLY - light antenna payload only
Compatible circular antenna + feeds
145 MHz and 435 MHz band-specific orthogonal feed paths
Each band: characterize RHCP and LHCP independently
Measure axial ratio in each hand/state; no result assumed
POL - limited axial roll (third axis)
Model-defined travel TBD; +/-90 deg is a proposal only
Roll does not invert circular handedness
EL elevation yoke / drive
Moving mass includes POL motor, encoder and cable
AZ azimuth base / drive
BASE belt concept; physical assembly/load untested
3-axis motor / encoder
50-ohm RF feed harness
POL-limited torsion loop; no continuous rotation
No unrated RF slip ring
HOLD: the legacy ESP32 carrier is AZ/EL only (two driver channels); it is not the new 3-axis controller.
Do not fabricate, wire, or transmit from this concept. RF switching stays independent of POL and inhibited during TX; all sensors and limits require approved interfaces and measured tests.
GPIO/expander enable and E-stop monitor signals are requests/monitors, not hardware permits; external hard-stop/watchdog/E-stop guard is not designed/released.
